summary: A study route through Dante Leon’s distance-management discussion and coming-up material from X, De La Riva, reverse De La Riva and butterfly guard.
description: Choose one starting guard in Wrestling Up From Guard and locate the opponent-response sections that belong to it.
overview: This course groups coming-up attacks by starting guard. Its opening distance discussion offers a common study question before the outline separates into X/De La Riva, reverse De La Riva and butterfly material.

guide.display_title: Dante Leon: Wrestling Up From Guard

fits: You want to study coming up from guard and need to choose a starting position rather than collect unrelated stand-ups.
consider_alternative_if: For reverse-De-La-Riva recovery and inversion branches beyond wrestling up, compare Leon’s dedicated reverse-De-La-Riva guide.

includes: Distance and reaction discussion followed by X-guard and De La Riva material.
Reverse De La Riva responses and a separate butterfly section.
limits: The course starts from guard; its outline is not a general standing-wrestling curriculum.

start_here.title: Compare two reverse-De-La-Riva situations
start_here.task: Find the knee-down and squared-up opponent lessons in volume 2. Use those labels to sort two exchanges from your own notes or available footage. Record the opponent posture before the bottom player rises; keep observations separate from explanations of the mechanics.
start_here.section: Volume 1: Distance Management (Standing vs Seated) — 5:38 (course timestamp)
